run_prithvi_geospatial_inference: run online inference on a geotiff image using the Prithvi-EO vLLM pooling endpoint
build_geotiff_request_payload: build a JSON request payload for sending a geotiff image URL to the vLLM pooling server
decode_base64_tiff_response: decode a base64-encoded tiff image response from the vLLM pooling API
write_tiff_output_file: write a decoded tiff image to disk from a base64-encoded vLLM response
post_geospatial_inference_request: post a geospatial inference request with model name and image URL to the vLLM pooling endpoint
